build_object_detection_output: build object detection output from model logits and predicted boxes with a confidence threshold
run_image_guided_detection: run image-guided one-shot object detection with NMS threshold and target image sizes
test_pad_image: test padding a numpy image to a square shape with zeros
refactor_resize_image: refactor resizing an image with anti-aliasing and scipy zoom to target dimensions
summarize_box_iou: summarize computing intersection-over-union between two sets of bounding boxes
